content: Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn atza akhebha Phero

Ayongi mẹ, Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn atza akhebha Phero, aben bi, “Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Israẹl, obeni bi, ‘Tte anọng paam ọbọhk afona, ifha bẹ atza asi ọdadaami kw'ikpokpobha k'ibe s'anọng an-arukhi, anang-m.’ ”
Mẹ wọ, Phero oben bi, “Anyi wọ ode Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kwa kaam nnọbh ka chen maa, ntte anọng p'Israẹl ọbọhk bẹ afona? Kaam Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kinnong! Anọng p'Israẹl ọbọhk kíntte bẹ afona.”

Iwa Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn, aben bi, “Ibinọkpaabyi kw'abaHiburu okk'man abẹ ottema. Mẹ wọ, tte mobina orenga kw'iwu ittaan mochina k'ibe s'anọng an-arukhi, ifha mọtza osi njafọhni ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwaman. Oni mando ode, kẹ ọfha ọnang man ihem k'adem-k'adem, ayongi mẹ, ofha ofhu man ttara ọkkangkkaang.”
Yina, ọvaarnọng kw'Ijip ọn-ọbọbh Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn bi, “Ode yan kwa bọng akwọbh anọng mba ọtzọhm fa bẹ am-asi o? Bọng kpa nnam k'itzọhm sabọng!”
Mẹ wọ, Phero oben bi, “Bọng kker e, anọng p'irek nna akk'an-ahaabha, yina, bọng am-akwọbha bẹ ọtzọhm osisi.”
M'ewu nduma dani, Phero ọnang akker-atzọhmnọng ọmaana akkeri-itzọhm ẹfa bi:
“Bọng anọng mba araraari-bukhi pa bẹ am-atzima abanga atza dọk kànang. Tte bẹ areng-mmo atza aror araraari-bukhi pa bẹ am-aztima abanga atza.
Yina, bọng si bẹ abanga ọtzabhik kwa bẹ am-akkekkeni abanga, bọng kàjekhi. Bẹ akpọhr-ọkpọhra e, kwẹ gwọ osi bẹ am-abhom bi, ‘Tte mofona, mọtza osi ẹjafọhni ọnang Ibinọkpaabyi kwaman.’
Bọng si ọtzọhm mva fẹ ọgaang-ọgaangi ọnang ajinọng mba, ifha bẹ am-asi ọtzọhm, bẹ aningi ogbe akhaam kwa bẹ ayonga itzọhng k'ibhora manda rani.”
Mẹ wọ, akker-atzọhmnọng ọmaana akkeri-itzọhm p'Israẹl, afona atza agbaak anọng mba bi, “Ma wọ ode odik kwa Phero ọgbaakhi: ‘Kaam bọng araraaribukhi pa bẹ am-atzima abanga atza dọk kinnang.
Bọng nọhng atza aror araraari-bukhi, pa bẹ am-atzima abanga atza k'ibe sa bọng aroror, yina, ọtzọhm fabọng kòjekhi mebubuni.’ ”
Mẹ wọ, anọng mba an-akpaanga makhọra Ijip, aror araraari-bukhi pa bẹ atzima abanga atza.
Akker-atzọhmnọng mba achina ororo anyuni bẹ k'ẹfa, aben bi, “Bọng kyera ọtzọhm fabọng f'ewu, macha bọng am-akkekkeni asi, k'ogbe kwa bẹ am-anang bọng araraari-bukhi.”

Akker-atzọhmnọng pa Phero otzek, abọkha akkeri-itzọhm p'Israẹl attum ngwur, abira abọbh bẹ bi, “Okhuri yan kw'ọtzabhik kwa bọng abang ikhena ttara mayina, oni obhik kwa bọng am-akkekkeni abanga opyir o?”
Mẹ wọ, akkem-itzọhm p'Israẹl afona atza abhom akpẹkhi Phero, aben-ẹ bi, “Itta, okhuri yan kwa kọ am-asi atzọhmnọng pọ manda o?
Bẹ atzọhmnọng pọ araraari-bukhi pa bẹ am-atzima abanga atza dọk kanangi. Yina, bẹ am-aben man bi, ‘Bọng banga atza!’ Bẹ am-attum atzọhmnọng pọ, kaambi ode bi ottotto ode kw'anọng pọ.”
Phero obhina bẹ bi, “Ọkpọra e, bọng akpọr-ọkpọra e! Kwẹ wọ osi bọng am-aben bi, ‘Tte mofona, motza osi ẹjafọhni ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.’
Bọng kpa nnam k'ọtzọhm. Bẹ bọng araraari-bukhi pa bẹ am-atzima abanga atza kánang, yina, bọng akhaambi abanga ọtzabhik kwa bọng am-akkekkeni abanga.”
Akkeri-itzọhm p'Israẹl akwu atzin bi, odik wọ om-otto mẹ, da bẹ abeni bi, “Bọng ọtzabhik kwa bọng am-abanga kw'ewu kàkhaambi ajekhi.”
Mada bẹ abin ka Phero, bẹ are Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn p'am-atzik bẹ,
bẹ aben bi, “Tte Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ore bọng, ọkpaara aponga pabọng! Bọng akk'asa mopyibh k'itzitzikha sa Phero, ọmaana akhaan-nọng pẹ, bọng abira khe bẹ ọkkangkkaang k'ọbọhk bi, bẹ afhu man.”
Ibinọkpaabyi ochekhi bi, ọ́rọbha anọng p'Israẹl k'ebira
Mẹ wọ e, Mosẹs ọkpa nnam k'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, oben bi, “O Itta, okhuri yan kwa akhe anọng mba ka dama-dama o? Kwẹ wọ osi atzọhm-m o?
Tzọni k'ogbe kwa ndim che chọ nda mgbaak Phero atzim, ọkk'anọng mba ọkha ka dama-dama, kọ bẹ kabira akkaana mebubuni.”
